text_en: Now concerning the collection for the saints: you should follow the directions I gave to the churches of Galatia.
text_cn: 关于为圣徒捐款的事，我怎样给迦拉达各教会规定了，你们也该照样做。

text_en: On the first day of every week, each of you is to put aside and save whatever extra you earn, so that collections need not be taken when I come.
text_cn: 每周的第一日，你们每人要照自己的能力积蓄一点，各自存放着，免得我来到时才现凑。

text_en: And when I arrive, I will send any whom you approve with letters to take your gift to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 几时我一来到，就派你们所认可的人，带着信，把你们的恩施送到耶路撒冷去；

text_en: If it seems advisable that I should go also, they will accompany me.
text_cn: 若是值得我也去，他们就同我一起去。

text_en: I will visit you after passing through Macedonia—for I intend to pass through Macedonia—
text_cn: 我巡行了马其顿以后，就往你们那里去，因为我只愿巡行马其顿；

text_en: and perhaps I will stay with you or even spend the winter, so that you may send me on my way, wherever I go.
text_cn: 但在你们那里，可能我要住下，甚或过冬，以后我无论往那里去，你们可以给我送行，

text_en: I do not want to see you now just in passing, for I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
text_cn: 因为这次我不愿只路过时见见你们；主若准许，我就希望在你们那里多住一些时候；

text_en: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
text_cn: 但我仍要在厄弗所逗留到五旬节，

text_en: for a wide door for effective work has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
text_cn: 因为有成效的大门已给我敞开了，但也有许多敌对的人。

text_en: If Timothy comes, see that he has nothing to fear among you, for he is doing the work of the Lord just as I am;
text_cn: 若是弟茂德到了，你们要留意，叫他在你们那里无恐无惧，因为他是办理主的工作，如同我一样，

text_en: therefore let no one despise him. Send him on his way in peace, so that he may come to me; for I am expecting him with the brothers.
text_cn: 所以谁也不可轻视他。以后，你们当送他平安起程，回到我这里，因为我与弟兄们等候着他。

text_en: Now concerning our brother Apollos, I strongly urged him to visit you with the other brothers, but he was not at all willing to come now. He will come when he has the opportunity.
text_cn: 关于阿颇罗弟兄，我多次恳求他，要他同弟兄们一起到你们那里去，但他决没有意思如今去；一有好机会，他一定会去。

text_en: Keep alert, stand firm in your faith, be courageous, be strong.
text_cn: 你们应当儆醒，应屹立在信德上，应有丈夫气概，应刚强有力。

text_en: Let all that you do be done in love.
text_cn: 你们的一切事，都应以爱而行。

text_en: Now, brothers and sisters, you know that members of the household of Stephanas were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints;
text_cn: 弟兄们，我还要劝告你们：你们知道斯特法纳一家原是阿哈雅的初果，且自愿委身服事圣徒；

text_en: I urge you to put yourselves at the service of such people, and of everyone who works and toils with them.
text_cn: 对这样的人，和一切合作劳苦的人，你们应表示服从。

text_en: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus, because they have made up for your absence;
text_cn: 斯特法纳和福突纳托及阿哈依科来了，我很喜欢，因为他们填补了你们的空缺；

text_en: for they refreshed my spirit as well as yours. So give recognition to such persons.
text_cn: 他们使我和你们的心神都感到了快慰。对他们这样的人，你们应知敬重。

text_en: The churches of Asia send greetings. Aquila and Prisca, together with the church in their house, greet you warmly in the Lord.
text_cn: 亚细亚各教会问候你们；阿桂拉和普黎史拉以及他们家内的教会，在主内多多问候你们。

text_en: All the brothers and sisters send greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
text_cn: 所有的弟兄都问候你们；你们也该以圣吻彼此问候。

text_en: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand.
text_cn: 我保禄亲笔问候。

text_en: Let anyone be accursed who has no love for the Lord. Our Lord, come!
text_cn: 若有人不爱主，该受诅咒！吾主，来吧！

text_en: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
text_cn: 愿主耶稣的恩宠与你们同在！

text_en: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus.
text_cn: 愿我的爱在基督耶稣内与你们众人同在！
